children: Murphy Oil will present at the Barclays Energy-Power Conference and disclosed updated 2Q/2026 results and guidance, including a $300M capex increase to $1.55B and Lac Da Vang first oil targeted in 4Q 2026.
CEO Eric Hambly presenting at Barclays conference and hosting investor meetings; presentation furnished as Exhibit 99.1.
Updated FY2026 capex raised $300M to $1.55B to fund Bubale appraisal, Eagle Ford acceleration and Chinook #8.
Lac Da Vang (Golden Camel) on track for first oil in 4Q 2026; gross recoverable ~100 MMBOE and ~$10/BOE development CAPEX.
Bubale discovery in Côte d’Ivoire encountered 100 ft net oil pay; pred rill recoverable range 340–850 MMBOE; Bubale West appraisal initiated.
2Q metrics: liquidity ~$2.5B, net debt $1.07B, adjusted EBITDAX $632M (YTD), free cash flow $110M; board repurchase program with $550M returned/remaining actions.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
